name: EDAG Kelpie CLI
description: Installs the EDAG Kelpie CLI (Ephyne AI gateway proxy) for the container user.

atBuild.description: "never" (default): no build-time login attempt; setup-clis.sh installs Kelpie at container create and the edag-kelpie-login helper completes the device-code sign-in in your first terminal. "optional": also try to bake Kelpie into the image (redeem the SharePoint device-code login shown in the build log in a browser if one appears).

installerUrl.description: URL of the Kelpie bootstrap installer.
